title: Bulwer-Lytton offered the crown of Greece

tellings.quote: >> Look at Edward Bullwward Linton. At one point he was offered the crown of Greece and he declined it.

plain: The British writer Edward Bulwer-Lytton, author of a novel called The Coming Race, was at one point offered the crown of Greece and turned it down. The researcher Jason Jorjani says this in passing on an episode about Nazi Germany and flying saucers, without naming a source. He offers it as a sign of how much standing Bulwer-Lytton had in his day.
